Senses.Explanation: The five ranks of lord and minister are the named Caodong set arranging five paired positions through lord-and-minister language. Records attribute verses to Dongshan, place the set beside other house vocabularies, and debate later ordering; the entry describes the attested set without supplying an imposed solution.
